newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Italian, U.S. firms qualify for Argentine tender.
newsitem.headline: Italian, U.S. firms qualify for Argentine tender.

text.p: Four groups with Argentine, Italian and U.S. capital qualified to bid for the tender of energy transmission firm Empresa Social de Energia de Buenos Aires (Eseba), provincial officials said Monday.
Buenos Aires province officials quoted by the state-controlled Telam news agency said the four groups were:
* Lineas de Transmision de Buenos Aires, made up of Argentine companies Sideco Americana, Cartellone, Pirelli, and Codi.
* U.S.-controlled AES Development of Argentina, and CEA Americas Operating.
The government of Buenos Aires province plans to open bids for the 95-year Eseba concession July 18, and transfer control of the company to the winner August 1.
Eseba operates 3,400 miles (5,500 km) of transmission lines.
